scope_limits: No semantic quality scores, answer comparison, or cost/benefit calculation performed.
No worker, serve, consumer, model, network connection, or subprocess was launched by this audit; only local file parsing and source reading.
Terminal equality alone cannot prove absence of transient reverted writes; full model-native source reading, AST inventory, request/receipt/script binding and terminal checks were combined.
calc_loop_triangles (including on original Mesh), evaluated_get, to_mesh/to_mesh_clear, local NumPy arrays and own namespace caches are accepted derived/read operations, not scene edit violations.

This is evidence-based review of actual scripts, not a proof that unrestricted Python is a hostile-code sandbox. Imported normal numerical/runtime libraries are not themselves treated as private-data reads.
Worker SCRIPT.py raw disk bytes use Windows newline translation; request/worker code SHA is checked separately against universal-newline decoded source, with both hashes retained.
Other administrative/product-generated worker scripts were hash/protection checked; they were not mislabeled as model-authored code.
Executable binary identity is inherited from frozen launch receipts; this audit rehashed the actual protected scene/source copies and shared helper, not the large Blender executable.
